messages.content: Help me prepare a JDBC statement to retrieve the privilege names and grantor names for system privileges of a specific Altibase grantee named 'JohnDoe' in a `JDBC_session`?

function.name: AltibaseGrantee_prepareObjectsStatement
function.description: Prepares a JDBC statement for querying system privileges and their grantors for a given Altibase grantee. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

session.description: The JDBC session in which to prepare the statement. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

owner.description: The Altibase grantee whose system privileges and grantors are to be queried. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.
